read.thesis: Comparable sales ex-gas and FX held near 6.7% with core-on-core margin up 18bp ex-tariff items, but capex stepped up to ~$7.5B for FY27 as warehouse openings rise to a 30-a-year run rate.

capex.quote: For fiscal year 2027, we are planning approximately $7.5 billion in capital expenditure.

triggers.label: FY27 capex ~$7.5B vs $6.4B
triggers.quote: For fiscal year 2027, we are planning approximately $7.5 billion in capital expenditure.

triggers.label: 33 openings FY27, 30 net a year
triggers.quote: Our current plan is to open another 33 warehouses in fiscal year 2027, of which 5 are relocations

triggers.label: Tariff refunds reinvested in price
triggers.quote: we reinvested some of these dollars to give value back to our members

triggers.label: LIFO charge $152M vs $43M
triggers.quote: We had a $152 million LIFO charge in Q4 this year compared to a $43 million charge in Q4 last year.

guidance.quote: Our current plan is to open another 33 warehouses in fiscal year 2027, of which 5 are relocations
For fiscal year 2027, we are planning approximately $7.5 billion in capital expenditure.

guidance.value: majority of refunds reinvested in member value
guidance.quote: we intend to continue reinvesting the majority of the dollars we receive in increased member values

red_flags.label: Membership growth decelerating 8 quarters
red_flags.quote: with kind of 8 quarters in a row where the membership growth has slowed

red_flags.label: Gross margin down 11bp; LIFO charge up sharply
red_flags.quote: We had a $152 million LIFO charge in Q4 this year compared to a $43 million charge in Q4 last year.

evasions.quote: obviously, we don't give guidance as we think about particular metrics.
it's difficult to predict what's going to happen with inflation.
